load_conf: load a Hydra config from a YAML file with optional overrides and unnesting
validate_conf: validate a YAML config file against a Python dataclass type using promote_config
validate_nested_conf: validate a nested YAML config file with a top-level config key against a dataclass
validate_line_processor_conf: validate a line processor config file against a dataclass type
instantiate_module: instantiate a StopesModule from a YAML config file mimicking CLI behavior
